entries.subject: docs(material/snack-bar): fix broken doc example (#27686)
entries.reason: The patch only replaces an example comment in Material's snack-bar.md. This package does not contain that markdown or the snack-bar-annotated-component example.

entries.subject: docs: mat-error can only rendered if the input has touched and is invalid state (#27752)
entries.reason: The patch removes the word either from Material's input.md. The sentence still says an error shows when the control is invalid and touched, or the parent form is submitted. This package does not contain that markdown.

entries.subject: docs(material/slider): clarify behavior of slider range thumbs (#27846)
entries.reason: The patch renames the documented range-thumb selectors in Material's slider.md and says the start thumb cannot exceed the end thumb. This package has neither that markdown nor matSliderStartThumb.

entries.subject: docs(material/slider): Page Up/Down increase value but not by 10 steps (#27854)
entries.reason: The SHA only edits Material slider.md (Page Up step wording). This package does not contain that markdown. Owned legacy-slider still uses _increment(10); that behavior is a separate adaptation question, not closed by this docs SHA.

entries.subject: docs(material/datepicker): recommend installing adapters through ng add
entries.reason: The patch tells readers to install the date-fns, Luxon, and Moment adapters with ng add. This package does not contain that markdown.

entries.subject: docs(material/chips): remove instructions to announce deletion (#28253)
entries.reason: The patch deletes a docs sentence that told chip users to announce removal with LiveAnnouncer. This package does not contain that markdown, and the owned chip sources do not mention LiveAnnouncer.

entries.subject: docs(material/icon): add guidance for Material Symbols (#28436)
entries.reason: The patch adds Material Symbols guidance and switches the upstream dev-app font class. This package does not contain the dev-app or icon.md.

entries.subject: docs(cdk/scrolling): fix typo (#28549)
entries.reason: The patch inserts the word is in CDK scrolling.md. This package does not contain that markdown.

entries.subject: docs(material/progress-bar): remove old MDC guide
entries.reason: The patch replaces the MDC progress-bar setup guide with a link to the public docs. This package does not contain that README.

entries.subject: docs(material/slider): value should go in the input tag (#28257)
entries.reason: The SHA only moves value onto the inner input in Material slider.md. This package does not contain that markdown.

entries.subject: fix(material/datepicker): deprecate constructor injection in NativeDateAdapter (#26144)
entries.reason: NativeDateAdapter lives in @angular/material/core. This package only re-exports LegacyNativeDateAdapter from the peer and does not implement the adapter.

entries.subject: fix(material/progress-bar): avoid CSP issues for apps not using buffer mode (#28946)
entries.reason: Owned legacy progress-bar template uses an inline SVG pattern for the buffer track and does not render mdc-linear-progress__buffer-dots.
entries.source_check: legacy-progress-bar/progress-bar.html SVG pattern; no buffer-dots class

entries.subject: fix(material/progress-bar): avoid CSP issues due to buffer dots (#31818)
entries.reason: Owned progress-bar styles have no data-URI mask. The CSP buffer-dots change targets MDC styles this package does not ship on the progress-bar path.

entries.subject: perf(material/tooltip): Defer injection of injectables not needed until tooltip is shown. (#30440)
entries.reason: Deferred Overlay/ScrollDispatcher/ViewContainerRef/DOCUMENT injection is a performance change, not a security-sink change for this package.
entries.source_check: security-deep note classification retained after review

entries.subject: refactor: move trusted types logic into CDK (#32387)
entries.reason: trustedHTMLFromString / icon-registry trusted-types move is not owned here; package has no cdk/private trusted-types helper.
entries.source_check: no trustedHTMLFromString or @angular/cdk/private import in projects/ngx-material-legacy

entries.subject: fix(cdk/layout): avoid CSS injection attacks in media matcher
entries.reason: Owned MediaMatcher call site passes the constant (prefers-reduced-motion) query with no braces. This disposition does not claim the installed CDK peer contains the strip fix.

entries.subject: fix(material/autocomplete): don't assign to model value while typing when requireSelection is enabled (#27572)
entries.reason: legacy-autocomplete/internal/autocomplete-trigger-base.ts already skips _onChange while typing when requireSelection is set.

entries.subject: fix(material/dialog): update aria-labelledby if title is swapped (#27609)
entries.reason: MatLegacyDialogTitle pushes/splices ids on _ariaLabelledByQueue; container binds aria-labelledby to the first queued id.

entries.subject: docs(material/autocomplete): fix autocomplete typo (#27662)
entries.reason: legacy-autocomplete/internal/autocomplete-base.ts already spells autocomplete correctly on requireSelection comments/API.

entries.subject: fix(material/autocomplete): requireSelection incorrectly resetting value when there are no options
entries.reason: autocomplete-trigger-base.ts already captures attach value via _captureValueOnAttach and compares against it for requireSelection.

entries.subject: fix(material/tabs): nav bar not navigating on enter presses (#27862)
entries.reason: tab-nav-bar-base.ts _handleKeydown clicks on Enter and Space when a tab panel is set, and prevents the key when disabled.

entries.subject: Toggle aria-modal attribute in parent modal when autocomplete panel opens / closes (#27663)
entries.reason: openPanel/closePanel already add/remove aria-owns on the tracked parent modal for the panel id.

entries.subject: fix(material/button): fix color tokens of raised buttons (#27904)
entries.reason: styles/button/_button-theme.scss already themes .mat-mdc-raised-button with protected tokens and dark disabled ink at 0.5 opacity.

entries.subject: refactor: use enum instead of const enum (#28052)
entries.reason: Owned LegacyRippleState is already export enum. Package has no const enum declarations; peer-reexported enums follow the installed Material/CDK.
entries.source_check: legacy-core/ripple/ripple-ref.ts export enum LegacyRippleState; no const enum in package
